about: Which LLM each Daily Brief job uses, and what we know about each model. Read by data-collect/extract/models.py (Python jobs), vibe-check/generate.mjs and scripts/update_calendar.py. A role's chain is tried in order when a call fails; each env var, if set, replaces the model at that position. Switching a model is a one-line change here; run bench_live.py / bench_science.py first. Prices are USD per million tokens at the standard tier, used to estimate cost where the provider reports none (Google direct; Flex is half).

budget.about: Rolling 24h spend from processed/llm-usage.jsonl. Past daily_usd every paid call switches to over_budget_model; past hard_daily_usd only free-tier calls run and the rest fail (callers retry later). Expected spend is under $1/day.

extract.chosen: bench_live.py 2026-11-05: 100% valid JSON, judge 4.06, 12% made-up details, 2.4s p50 (qwen3-32b: 65%, 3.73, 27%, 66s)

science.chosen: bench_science.py 2026-11-06 on 30 articles: 3.8 Flash low 16/30 accepted, 0 truncated, judge 5.00/4.38/3.88; 2.5 Flash 13/30, 11 truncated; 3.1 Flash-Lite 9/30, 13 caveat quotes rejected

review_events.chosen: A/B 2026-11-03 on 14 shortlist pages: same verdicts as 2.5 Flash at half the cost
